contentCn:
当你还是个新生儿时，没有人能看到你的牙齿。它们只是藏在你的牙龈里等着长大的小牙胚。到了6个月至1岁的时候，你的乳牙开始冒出来。到你2岁左右，你已经有了全部20颗乳牙。

当你大约6岁时，恒牙开始长出来。如果你还没有看到它们，别着急，它们很快就会冒出来！它们会一个个地把你的乳牙推掉。当所有恒牙都长出来时，你会有32颗牙齿。听起来好像有点多，但你的下颌（hé）也会长大，为它们腾出空间。
contentEn:
When you were a newborn, no one could see your teeth. They were just tiny tooth buds hiding in your gums, waiting to grow. Around 6 months to 1 year old, your baby teeth start to come in. By about age 2, you have all 20 baby teeth.

Around age 6, your permanent teeth start to come in. If you don't see them yet, don't worry—they'll come in soon! They will push out your baby teeth one by one. When all your permanent teeth are in, you will have 32 teeth. That sounds like a lot, but your jaw will grow too, making room for them.
